cold_start.name: cold_start
cold_start.description: The first 60 requests after a >=10 min idle gap in the trace, arriving within 20 min, with varied prompt lengths (not one scripted client): what a replica woken from zero sees.

steady_interactive.name: steady_interactive
steady_interactive.description: A steady busy 10-minute window (200-300 requests, no minute above 2x the window mean): a warm replica under real load.

long_context.name: long_context
long_context.description: 60 consecutive trace requests of >=3000 tokens, paired with long WildChat prompts and histories: prefill and KV pressure.

spike.name: spike
spike.description: A real burst: a minute of 40-150 requests after ten quiet minutes, with five minutes of lead-in and three of tail.

mixed_1.name: mixed_1
mixed_1.description: A real 20-minute window that crosses regimes (a post-idle burst, a spike and steady traffic) at <=1.1 req/s, each window from a different trace day. No class SLO: each request is judged by the SLO of its `regime` label.

mixed_2.name: mixed_2
mixed_2.description: A real 20-minute window that crosses regimes (a post-idle burst, a spike and steady traffic) at <=1.1 req/s, each window from a different trace day. No class SLO: each request is judged by the SLO of its `regime` label.

mixed_3.name: mixed_3
mixed_3.description: A real 20-minute window that crosses regimes (a post-idle burst, a spike and steady traffic) at <=1.1 req/s, each window from a different trace day. No class SLO: each request is judged by the SLO of its `regime` label.

notes: Real-trace corpus. Timing + sessions: BurstGPT v2.0 BurstGPT_3.csv (HPMLL, CC-BY-4.0); mixed_* also draw on BurstGPT_1.csv and _2.csv (earlier months, no sessions) on _3's clock. Text: WildChat-1M @7d6490e46228 shards 0-1 (allenai, ODC-BY), English, not toxic/flagged/redacted, no conversation containing a credential-like string (SECRET_RE). Azure LLM inference trace 2024 (CC-BY-4.0) is fetched as a cross-source check only, not a split (no sessions; see corpus/README.md). Tokenizer Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B@ad44e777bcd1, chat template enable_thinking=False, prompt cap 16384, max_tokens 2048. Seed 20261001. Splits: seen = even weeks of the trace, heldout = odd weeks. `dilation` per trace: arrival_s = real offset x dilation; replay with --rate-scale <dilation> for real timing. Each request's build_prompt_tokens is its templated length under this tokenizer. mixed_* requests carry `regime`, the class whose SLO judges them. SLOs proposed 2026-10-01, pending owner confirmation.
